title: Structure and Function of Chromosomal DNA
objectives: Describe the organization of DNA into chromosomes
Explain chromatin structure and its functional significance

dna_organization.title: DNA Packaging
dna_organization.content:
• Nucleosomes: DNA wrapped around histone octamers
  • Chromatin: Euchromatin (active) vs Heterochromatin (inactive)
  • Condensation: 30nm fiber → looped domains → metaphase chromosome

chromosomal_features.title: Chromosome Anatomy
chromosomal_features.content:
Key Features
• Telomeres: Protective end caps (TTAGGG repeats)
• Centromeres: Sister chromatid attachment site
• Origins of replication: Replication initiation points

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.content:
Why do telomeres shorten with age?

Due to the end-replication problem where DNA polymerase cannot fully replicate linear chromosome ends (solved in stem cells by telomerase).
